title: 2 v 2 Play Fast with Support
description: A high-tempo 2-on-2 game with offensive support players positioned in each end. Players use the support options to keep possession moving, attack quickly, and create immediate scoring chances.
coaching_points: Play quickly after gaining possession and use support instead of holding the puck.
Support players scan early and move the puck in one or two touches when possible.
Defenders keep sticks in passing lanes and angle attackers away from the middle.
Transition immediately when possession changes.

title: 1 on 1 Re-Gap Transition
description: A 1-on-1 transition drill that trains defenders to reset their feet, establish a useful gap, and steer the puck carrier away from the middle before the attack can enter cleanly.
coaching_points: Transition efficiently from backward to forward skating without losing inside position.
Close the gap early and defend from the middle out.
Lead with stick-on-puck pressure before using body position.
Force the attacker toward low-risk ice and contest the entry.

title: Weak Side Transition
description: A two-part transition sequence that starts with offensive-zone pressure and changes direction on the coach's signal. Players reload through the weak side, recover proper routes, and turn the play into a transition attack.
coaching_points: Reload through the middle with urgency when possession changes.
Weak-side support accelerates underneath the puck to become an option.
Defenders read the developing rush and protect the middle first.
Attackers recognize when the transition creates a 2-on-1 and use width.

title: 3 on 3 Transition Game
description: A competitive 3-on-3 game built around fast changes of possession. Teams must recognize the turnover, organize quickly on defense, and attack before the opposition can recover.
coaching_points: Attack immediately after winning possession and create a quick scoring threat.
Use quick shots, tips, rebounds, and net drives instead of overhandling.
Defenders communicate, protect the middle, and keep sticks in lanes.
Move the puck cleanly to start the next transition.

title: Avery 3 on 2 Drill
description: A reaction-based 3-on-2 rush drill. The coach starts the sequence through a defender, the puck is moved to the opposite group of forwards, and players immediately organize into a live odd-man rush.
coaching_points: Forwards react to the first pass and fill three useful attack lanes.
Support the puck through the middle instead of skating in straight parallel lines.
Defenders establish a tight gap and protect the middle of the ice.
Read the rush rather than predetermining the next play.

title: 2 v 2 Shawzy
description: A fast 2-on-2 transition battle that begins from the neutral zone. A coach activates one side with a pass, forcing both teams to identify offense and defense instantly and play the rush at speed.
coaching_points: Offensive players attack immediately and support the puck through open ice.
Defenders surf the rush, maintain a useful gap, and angle outside.
Use chips or soft-area passes when direct possession is taken away.
React instantly to which side receives the coach's pass.

title: 3 v 3 Neutral Zone Break Game
description: A 3-on-3 neutral-zone game that rewards teams for creating a clean break in transition. Players battle for possession, use available release options, and attack quickly when a new puck or outlet creates space.
coaching_points: Recognize transition opportunities before the defense gets set.
Support underneath the puck and communicate on outlet options.
Defenders protect the middle and close passing lanes with active sticks.
Attack the net quickly once the transition is created.

title: L-Support - Basic Triangle Movement
description: A three-player support progression built around triangle spacing. Players move with the puck, maintain multiple passing options, and learn how support angles change as defenders are added.
coaching_points: Keep a triangle around the puck instead of flattening into one line.
Move after every pass to create the next support angle.
Present a clear forehand target and communicate.
Progress from unopposed movement to pressure while preserving spacing.

title: Neutral Zone Puck Races With Support
description: A neutral-zone puck race that continues into a support play after the race is won. The puck carrier must protect possession, create separation, and find the next available teammate under pressure.
coaching_points: Use body position to win and protect the puck at the end of the race.
Create space with a tight turn or deception before passing.
Support players communicate and arrive as useful passing options.
Progress to additional support and odd-man situations as players improve.

title: Short to Long 2 on 2
description: A two-stage 2-on-2 rush progression. Players first execute a shorter attack, then reset into a longer full-ice transition that challenges forwards to create separation and defenders to rebuild their gap.
coaching_points: Forwards use changes of lane and pace instead of skating straight lines.
Create confusion for defenders with crossing, width, and support.
Defenders close space early and keep attackers outside.
Maintain stick detail and body position through both rushes.

title: Continuous 2 on 2 with Ozone D Options
description: A continuous 2-on-2 game that adds offensive-zone defensemen as passing and shooting options. The sequence connects rush offense, gap control, low-zone play, and point support without stopping the drill.
coaching_points: Get pucks behind pressure and avoid high-risk turnovers at the offensive blue line.
Forwards isolate defenders and look for 2-on-1 opportunities below the dots.
Use the offensive defensemen when the middle is closed.
When the puck goes high, create a screen or tip option while defenders clear sticks and sight lines.

title: 3 v 2 to 5 v 5 Backcheck
description: A transition progression that begins as a 3-on-2 rush and builds into full 5-on-5 play as backcheckers recover. It connects rush decisions, tracking routes, defensive-zone organization, and offensive support.
coaching_points: Backcheckers recover through the middle on direct routes.
Defensemen protect the middle, maintain gap, and angle the rush outside.
Attackers support the puck through the entry instead of spreading too early.
Reorganize quickly into 5-on-5 responsibilities as players arrive.

title: Cross-Fire Passing
description: A confined possession game where teams score by moving the puck from one outside support player through the playing area to the support player on the opposite side. It emphasizes movement, passing lanes, and puck protection.
coaching_points: Move immediately after a pass to create a new lane.
Use give-and-go support and keep sticks available for quick touches.
Defenders angle the puck away from the middle and take away direct passing lanes.
Add touches or players to increase the decision-making demand.
